response.sql:
WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trader_type_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    trader_type_count,
    1.0 * trader_type_count / SUM(trader_type_count) OVER () AS share,
    AVG(trader_type_count) OVER () AS baseline
  FROM type_counts
),
kept AS (
  SELECT * FROM metrics WHERE trader_type_count > baseline
)
SELECT
  SUM(trader_type_count) AS kept_count_sum,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(trader_type_count - baseline) AS average_count_above_baseline
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Each joined advancedbehavior row contributes one count, including multiple rows for the same trader; NULL tradekind values form a group like any other value.
